_ordering_rationale: Applied Materials fiscal year se termine fin octobre. SSG = coeur (~74%), AGS = services recurrents (~25%), Display residuel.

kpis.signal: Coeur Applied ~74% du CA, equipements depot+etching+CMP, leader marche WFE
kpis.description_fr: Equipements de fabrication semi (depot, etching, CMP, implant ionique, inspection). Leader du marche WFE (Wafer Fab Equipment). Sert foundries (TSMC, Samsung), DRAM/NAND, logic.
kpis.description_en: Semiconductor fabrication equipment (deposition, etch, CMP, ion implant, inspection). WFE market leader. Serves foundries (TSMC, Samsung), DRAM/NAND, logic.

kpis.signal: Services + spare parts + upgrades sur base installee ~50k chambres, recurrents et marges premium
kpis.description_fr: Applied Global Services (AGS): support, spare parts, upgrades, retrofit sur base installee >50k chambres clients. ~25% du CA, marges premium, recurrent.
kpis.description_en: Applied Global Services (AGS): support, spare parts, upgrades, retrofit on installed base >50k client chambers. ~25% of revenue, premium margins, recurring.

kpis.signal: Segment Display en decrue (LCD declin), focus OLED + advanced displays, ~3% CA
kpis.description_fr: Equipements de fabrication display (LCD, OLED). En decrue depuis le pic 2021 (~1.6 Mds $). Segment residuel ~3% CA.
kpis.description_en: Display manufacturing equipment (LCD, OLED). Declining since 2021 peak (~$1.6B). Residual segment ~3% of revenue.

kpis.signal: Foundry/Logic stable ~67-68%, pic 2023 (Intel/TSMC capex), reste majoritaire vs Memory
kpis.description_fr: Part Semi Systems venant de Foundry/Logic (vs DRAM + NAND). Majoritaire (~67-68%), pic 77% en 2023 sur capex foundries. Expose au cycle logic/AI.
kpis.description_en: Share of Semi Systems from Foundry/Logic (vs DRAM + NAND). Majority (~67-68%), 77% peak in 2023 on foundry capex. Logic/AI cycle exposure.

_notes: Donnees 10-K Applied Materials FY21-FY25 (annee fiscale fin octobre). KPI 4-5 (Foundry Mix, AGS Subscription) estimes a partir des disclosures qualitatives 10-K.
